context: Animated supply chain Sankey diagram mapping raw materials → components → products → markets with particle flow effects
first_impression: Structurally honest Sankey encoding — link widths and node heights are fully data-driven by d3-sankey's layout algorithm with no hardcoded domains or scale manipulation.
what_works: Link stroke-width uses d3-sankey's computed `d.width` (proportional to flow value), and particle spawn rate scales with `link.value / 30`, providing a consistent redundant encoding; tooltip reports raw In/Out totals honestly.
what_doesnt: Particle `linkPoint` function uses linear interpolation instead of following the actual cubic-bezier path of `d3.sankeyLinkHorizontal`, so particles visually drift off the link paths — a rendering inconsistency; no key functions in `.data()` joins, which is benign here since there are no dynamic updates but would cause visual corruption on re-renders.
